quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You forgot to bring your permission slip, and your teacher is asking for it now.
quests.hint: You know you were responsible for something, and you did not do it.
quests.explanation: Forgetting something you were responsible for often makes you feel guilty.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You are sitting on an airplane for the very first time in your life.
quests.hint: This is a brand-new experience high above the ground.
quests.explanation: Trying something completely new, like flying for the first time, often makes people feel nervous.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your favorite pair of headphones stops working and cannot be fixed.
quests.hint: Something you use and love every day is now gone for good.
quests.explanation: Losing something you use and enjoy every day, with no way to fix it, makes you feel upset.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You see a small child crying because he cannot find his parents in the shop.
quests.hint: A small child needs help and is clearly frightened.
quests.explanation: Seeing a lost, frightened child naturally makes you feel concerned.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You open the door and your friends all shout 'Surprise!'
quests.hint: You had no idea this was about to happen.
quests.explanation: When something completely unexpected happens, you feel surprised.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You finally finish a big school project you worked on for two weeks.
quests.hint: A long, stressful task is finally done.
quests.explanation: Completing a big project after a lot of hard work makes you feel relieved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You wait in a very long, slow-moving line at the supermarket.
quests.hint: You want to leave, but you cannot go yet.
quests.explanation: Standing in a long, slow line makes you feel impatient.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your friend tells you, 'That was such a great idea you had!'
quests.hint: Someone just said something kind and positive about you.
quests.explanation: Receiving a compliment from a friend makes you feel pleased.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A large spider suddenly runs across the floor of your bedroom.
quests.hint: Many people have a strong fear of spiders.
quests.explanation: Seeing a large spider unexpectedly makes many people feel terrified.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally drop a heavy book in a completely silent library.
quests.hint: A loud noise just made everyone in the room look at you.
quests.explanation: Making a loud noise in a quiet place makes you feel embarrassed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your school team wins the regional championship after a very close match.
quests.hint: Your team worked so hard, and it just paid off.
quests.explanation: Winning a championship after hard work makes you feel thrilled - extremely excited and happy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You bite into what you think is an orange, but it turns out to be a whole lemon.
quests.hint: The taste is much stronger and more sour than you expected.
quests.explanation: Biting into something unexpectedly sour makes you feel shocked.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your alarm goes off at 6 AM for an early class you almost forgot about.
quests.hint: It is very early, and your body wants more rest.
quests.explanation: Waking up much earlier than usual naturally makes you feel sleepy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A classmate you barely know invites you to join their study group.
quests.hint: Someone included you when they did not have to.
quests.explanation: When someone kindly includes you, you usually feel grateful.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You watch a movie where the main character dies at the very end.
quests.hint: A character you cared about is gone.
quests.explanation: Watching a sad ending for a character you liked naturally makes you feel sad.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The electricity suddenly goes out in the middle of the night.
quests.hint: Everything goes dark without any warning.
quests.explanation: A sudden, unexpected change like the power going out makes you feel startled.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You cook a full meal completely by yourself for the very first time.
quests.hint: You tried something new, and it turned out well.
quests.explanation: Successfully doing something new and difficult by yourself makes you feel proud.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You bump into an old friend on the street whom you have not seen in five years.
quests.hint: You did not expect to see this person again, and here they are.
quests.explanation: Unexpectedly meeting an old friend again usually makes you feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You get a haircut, and you really do not like how it turned out.
quests.hint: You have to show everyone a style you do not like.
quests.explanation: Getting a haircut you dislike often makes you feel embarrassed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your family sets off on a long road trip to the mountains for the weekend.
quests.hint: Adventure and beautiful scenery are waiting for you.
quests.explanation: Starting a trip to a beautiful new place with your family usually makes you feel excited.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your neighbor leaves a handwritten thank-you card in your mailbox.
quests.hint: Someone took the time to write something kind just for you.
quests.explanation: Receiving a handwritten card from someone makes you feel touched.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally knock your drink off the table at a busy restaurant.
quests.hint: An accident just happened in public, and people noticed.
quests.explanation: Accidentally making a mess in public makes you feel flustered.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You sit on the beach and watch the sun slowly set over the ocean.
quests.hint: Beautiful, calm scenery can settle your mind.
quests.explanation: Watching a beautiful sunset like this often creates a feeling of peace.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You apply to join a school club, but you are not chosen this time.
quests.hint: You tried, but you were not picked this time.
quests.explanation: Being turned down for something you applied for often makes you feel discouraged.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A stranger picks up the wallet you dropped and hands it back to you.
quests.hint: Someone helped you without expecting anything back.
quests.explanation: When a stranger kindly helps you, you feel grateful.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Today is your very first day at a new part-time job.
quests.hint: You do not know anyone yet, and everything is brand new.
quests.explanation: Starting a new job usually makes people feel a little nervous at first.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: After heavy rain, a bright rainbow suddenly appears across the sky.
quests.hint: A beautiful, colorful natural sight has just appeared.
quests.explanation: Seeing a rainbow appear unexpectedly makes most people feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You say something without thinking, and it accidentally hurts your friend's feelings.
quests.hint: You did not mean to hurt anyone, but you did.
quests.explanation: Accidentally hurting someone's feelings makes you feel guilty.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You sit in the dentist's waiting room 45 minutes past your appointment time.
quests.hint: Time is passing slowly, and you just want it to be your turn.
quests.explanation: Waiting much longer than expected makes you feel impatient.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You pass a very difficult exam after weeks of hard studying.
quests.hint: The stress and hard work have finally paid off.
quests.explanation: Passing a difficult exam after a lot of studying makes you feel relieved.
